sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Warm amber sap beads from a crack in a huge trunk like the tree is breathing it out. It smells of honey, woodsmoke, and something older.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Sable Sap: in a calm moment, once per long rest, consume it to clear 2 Stress.
